sae_atlas_phase6_specificity.interpretation: Median = 1.015, 95% CI [1.011, 1.019]. The CI strongly excludes the paper's 2.36× — confirming this is a real non-replication, not a sample-size artifact.

topology_141_h123.metric: mean delta_combo_vs_null_p95 per domain (12 layers each)
topology_141_h123.interpretation: All three domain CIs exclude zero on the negative side OR straddle near-zero. external_lung mean Δ CI is decisively negative (matches the strict-max-null finding). immune is the closest to positive but its CI95 still includes negative values. Bootstrap confirms: H123 floor effect on MaxToki is genuine, not a single-layer artifact.

circuit_tracing_crispri.interpretation: Wilson 95% CI: [0.54525, 0.54686]. At N=1,458,016, the CI is essentially tight at the third decimal place. Both the observed 54.61% and the paper's 56.4% sit comfortably within their respective tight CIs but both are > 50% (chance) by ~80 SD — the headline 'near-chance' framing should read 'a few SD above chance, but small effect size'. Caveat: pair-level pseudoreplication likely inflates the effective N — see audit P4 (action A2 GroupKFold).
